semantics.capture: On each positive edge of clk, q captures d when areset is low, with no additional cycle latency.
semantics.reset: Active-high asynchronous reset sets all q bits to zero on assertion, independently of clk, and dominates clock capture while high.
semantics.hold: q holds between positive clock edges except for asynchronous reset assertion. Reset deassertion alone does not capture data.
semantics.initialization: No power-up initialization is specified; no defined initial q is required before a reset or capture event.
semantics.evidence: problem.txt: 8 D flip-flops with active high asynchronous reset; output reset to 0; triggered by positive edge of clk.

numeric.data: Eight independent one-bit state elements, represented by unsigned packed vectors [7:0].
